About the College
         Rukasen College, established on 1st September 1992, is a premier higher educational
institution in Karbi Anglong District of Assam. Since its establishment, it has been catering the need
of higher education of the youth of various tribal as well as non-tribal communities of Diphu Sub-
Division of Karbi Anglong, a Sixth Scheduled District of Assam. It is the result of enthusiastic and
farsighted group of leading personalities of the greater Bakalia region. Continuous and restless
visionary efforts of an energetic team led by Mr. H. N. Borah, the founder Principal of the college,
has been doing splendid service in the district. Luminaries, like Joysing Tokbi (Journalist), Sonasing
Terang (Former MAC), Dr. Jayanta Rongpi (Former MP), Late Sum Ronghang (Former State
Minister) and some other leading citizens were involved in this noble deed.

        The college was initially started in an abandoned building of the Forest Department and later
at the Bakaliaghat Higher Secondary School, Bakalia. As per resolution of the general meeting held
on 26th April 1992, the Sunpura Anchalik Grazing Committee of the locality allotted 60 Bighas of
land for the temporary construction of a building for the college. Local citizens and the Karbi
Anglong Autonomous Council (KAAC) were very much enthusiastic in extending valuable help in
men and materials to Rukasen College in surmounting its initial difficulties.

The college has been recognized under Section 2(F) and 12(B) of the UGC Act 1956 and recently, it
has been accredited ‘B+’ grade by NAAC. The college is affiliated under Assam University, Silchar
which has introduced the Four-Year Undergraduate (FYUG) program of NEP-2020 in the academic
session 2023-2024. The college has been imparting education in Arts streams only, and thus, it is a
single stream college with nine teaching departments. The college also provides Value Added
Courses under self-financed system in computer applications of short- and long-term courses in
collaboration with AMTRON, Guwahati.         In addition, the college is running an ODL centre of
KKHSOU, providing Undergraduate, Post Graduate, and Diploma courses in various subjects.

Vision
Rukasen College has the cherished vision to make it a seat of excellence and quality education and to
emerge as the most preferred educational institution with global recognition developing competent
and socially sensitive citizens committed to excellence. It is intended to mould the students with
knowledge, skill, right values and attitude and evolve as responsible citizens as they imbibe the core
values of the institution: Faith, Dignity, Integrity and Excellence. Such an education will certainly
regulate the students’ lives in such a manner as to make them emerge as true citizens of the country
in its true sense. It disseminates education to students irrespective of caste, creed, religion and sex in
humanities to meet the needs and aspirations of the people of Assam in general and Karbi Anglong in
particular. It is so oriented as to make the learners a high sense of discipline and dedication in order
to discharge their duties towards society and the nation. The students shall develop the college as an
ideal centre of learning for proper manifestation of the best in an individual learner’s mind and
character to make him a good citizen. We, the Rukasen family, have to march forward steadily with
firm determination to make the college as a centre of excellence.

Mission

To realize the long term vision of the college, the following strategies and measures are being
adopted:

Academic

       1. To achieve its cherished goals the IQAC of the college has adopted methodology suited for
           monitoring of the progress of each department;

       2. To find out the strengths and weaknesses of the present teaching-learning programs regular
           audit of the academic progress is conducted for better outcomes;

       3. To organize orientation course/faculty development programs for professionalizing the
           teaching-learning process;

       4. To introduce more vocational courses helpful for creating the learners eligible for
           employment;

       5. To organize workshops/discussions on tribal culture in a regular interval to acquaint the
           students with cultural tradition;

       6. To create better environment feasible for research with modern facilities;

       7. To impart futuristic education to prepare the learners for their every walk of life; and

       8. To encourage the students and the teachers in creating green environment in the campus.

Goals and Objectives

The college has the cherished vision to make it a seat of excellence and quality education, and to
emerge as the most preferred educational institution with global recognition developing competent
and socially sensitive citizens committed to excellence. The key aims and objectives of the college
are:

          To disseminate education in humanities to meet the needs and aspirations of the people of
           Assam in general and of Karbi Anglong In particular.
          To impart quality education to all learners irrespective of caste, creed, religion and sex.
          To impart futuristic education to prepare the learners for every walk of their life.

    duties towards society and nation.
   To develop the college as an ideal centre of learning for proper manifestation of the best in an

   To inspire students to promote their natural endowments and potential.
   To ensure access to education for academically and socially disadvantaged groups..

   To cultivate research aptitudes faculty members.
   To promote and sustaining social unity, integrity, and brotherhood among students.
   To draw awareness towards sustainable utilization of the biodiversity and environment.

FROM THE PRINCIPAL’S DESK




       Soon after taking over the charge of principal of Rukasen College, Bakalia in 2013, it became
my top priority to create an environment conducive for a good teaching-learning exercise. Keeping
in mind the pace with the changing world so that the college could emerge as a synonym for “distinct
Environment of Excellence in Education” for the new learners through the exemplary motto of
“Knowledge, Love and Service”. Simultaneously, the academic and extension activities of the
college are drawn from well defined goals of higher education to promote competent knowledge
citizens who are not only skilled, but are also morally upright and spiritually inspired with “humane
values and social commitment”. Keeping this point in view, I have attempted to develop the
infrastructure of the college with the active support of the faculties, office staff, students, guardians
and the leading well-wishers of the college. It would be wrong if I would not mention the
contribution of the Karbi Anglong Autonomous Council, which has always been with us for creating
a knowledge based environment through infrastructural development. I hope to have the same
amount of co-operation from all corners to secure the set objectives of the college within a specified
timeframe. Lastly, I would like to cite here a writing of Helen Keller: “alone we can do so little,
together we can do so much.”



                                                              Dr. Milan Banik

       2020
   3. Key Features of NEP 2020- Higher Education: Government of India adopted a massive
       educational policy for the nation in the year 2020. Higher education as per NEP-2020,
       focuses on multidisciplinary, holistic, and flexible curricula. It also emphasizes increased
       access, equity, and inclusivity in higher education. Furthermore, the policy promotes
       research, innovation, and the use of technology to enhance the learning experience.
       Internalization of higher education is given priority by the policy that encourages promoting
       collaborations with foreign institutions and attracting international students. Higher education
       also possesses other key features such as increasing the Gross Enrollment Ratio (GER) to
       50% by 2035, Technology Integration, Curriculum Reforming, Autonomy and Accountability
       of Higher Educational Institutions (HIEs).



       The undergraduate degree (UG) programme in the “Four Year Undergraduate Programme”
(FYUGP) is a Choice Based Credit System of educational program under Semester Scheme. The
candidate has an option to exit after TWO, FOUR and SIX semesters of the programme (at the end
of each academic year) and shall be awarded Certificate, Diploma, and Undergraduate degree with
Major respectively. Two consecutive (one odd and one even) semesters will make up an academic
year. An UG course shall be of eight semesters covering four Calendar Years (Academic Sessions –
July to June). The duration of the Odd Semesters (First, Third, Fifth and Seventh) shall be July -
December, and that of Even Semesters (Second, Fourth, Sixth and Eight) shall be January - June .
Each student must take admission in four consecutive academic sessions starting with the first
semester. Students who do not enroll in the second academic session will not be eligible to take
admission in the third academic session and fourth academic season. Similarly, a student who do not
enroll in the third academic session will not be eligible to take admission in the fourth academic

session. The programme permits horizontal mobility in course selections for the students. They may
pursue the three years or six semester programme within 5 years and four years or eight semester
programme within 7 years. The programme allows the students to re-enter the course within a time
of 3 years.

Main Features of FYUG:

             Academic Flexibility and Choice: Students can enjoy the freedom to choose minor
              subjects, alter major subjects at the beginning of the second year, and select courses on
              their interests and career goals.
             Multidisciplinary Approach: This is a Multidisciplinary approach to learning where
              students are capable of exploring various fields of study and developing a broader
              understanding of knowledge.
             Practical Skills and Internships: This program gives importance to practical skills
              development through internships during the program period.
             Outcomes-Based Curriculum: It focuses on outcome-based learning, which ensures that
              students acquire specific skills and knowledge associated with their chosen field of study.
             Flexibility in Program Structure: Students can choose to exit the program after
              completing one, two, or three years, earning a certificate, diploma, or bachelor's degree,
              respectively.

 OPEN LEARNING FACILITIES

KKHSOU STUDY CENTRE: CENTRE CODE:1607

       Krishna Kanta Handiqui State Open University (KKHSOU), the sole State Open University
in North East India, was founded under the KKHSOU Act, 2005, passed by the Government of
Assam and published in the Assam Gazette (extraordinary) on 29/09/2005. The university received
recognition from the former Distance Education Council (DEC), (now Distance Education Bureau,
UGC), New Delhi through letter no. DEC/Misc/07/5957 dated 03/10/2007. The University Grants
Commission, in a letter dated 18/03/2009 with reference no. F.9-13/2008(CPP-I), empowered the
university to confer Degrees under Section 22 of the UGC Act, 1956. Established as the 14thOpen
University in India, alongside IGNOU, the University's Headquarters is situated at Patgaon, Rani,
Guwahati. It commenced operations with the appointment of Prof. Srinath Baruah, former Professor
in the Department of Economics at Gauhati University, as its founder Vice-Chancellor.

       Established with the motto “Education Beyond Barriers”, KKHSOU aims to advance
education by reaching out to the learners irrespective of their age, academic background and
geographical constraints. The university is committed to delivering easily accessible and quality
higher education and training to all potential learners, incorporating the latest educational and
technological advancements. Due to the inherent flexibility in terms of learning pace, location, and
evaluation methods, the university pledges to provide equal opportunities for higher education and to
include those who had hitherto been deprived of education. The academic programmes of the
University are designed to extend education to learners throughout the region, with course structures
aligned with National Curriculum Standards. In addition to the traditional UG and PG programmes,
KKHSOU offers various professional Certificate and Diploma programmes, allowing even the
enrolled learners in various colleges, universities and other educational institutions to pursue
additional studies in the form of Add-on courses concurrently with their regular courses.




Education, with its formative impact on an individual’s mind, character and physical abilities, serves
as the backbone of a society. KKHSOU, with a robust learner base of more than 5 Lakhs, is
dedicated to fostering a knowledge-based society by delivering quality higher education through the
Open and Distance Learning (ODL) Mode in the North Eastern region of India and contributing the
increase GER in Higher education in a country like India. Starting from the academic session of July
2023, the university offers UG and PG programmes in accordance with the requirements of the NEP

STUDENT SUPPORT FACILITIES

Identity Card:

At the time of admission, every student shall be provided with an Identity Card and he/she shall
carry it at the time of attending the classes. An issued Identity Card is valid for one year (One
academic session). On expiry of the Identity Card; it has to be surrendered for renewal. Loss of
Identity Card should be reported to the Police immediately. A duplicate Identity Card shall be issued
to the student on receipt of the Police report and a fee of Rs.50/-.

Grievance Redress Cell:

The institution has its own Grievance Redress Cell to deal with the grievances of the students in a
time-bound and efficient manner. Monitoring of the grievances at regular intervals is done and
students’ opinions are taken for their satisfaction.

NSS Unit of the College:

National Service Scheme (NSS) Cell of Rukasen College was established in 2020 with the primary
objective of developing the personality and character of the student through voluntary community
Service. This cell was formally registered in 2022 under Assem University, Silchar. ‘’Education
Through service" was the main objective of NSS and Since then the college has been organizing
various programs inside and outside of the college including Awareness of Road Safety, awareness of
Tabacco control and cancer, Awareness of Antia drugs addiction, observation of world women Day,
World Environmental Day, International Day of Person’s with a disability, World AIDS Day, etc. By
this, the message is given To society about the essence of- democratic living and upholds the need
for selfless Service.

        1. Mission of NSS:-To promote social, economic, technological, and political change to
            expand civilization beyond Earth.
        2. The Goal of NSS: The main goal of NSS is "Education through community service and
           community service through education".

been mobilizing its resources to prepare students for facing the challenges of changing society. It has
been working amidst beautiful socio-cultural and natural environment and monitoring well-
